dataset: Pantheon+ (1,701 SNe Ia, full covariance matrix)
question: Does a flexible distance-redshift relation absorb the Chandrasekhar luminosity drift dm(z) = -7.5 eps log10(1+z)?

M1_NoLambda.verdict: EXCLUDED at Delta chi2 = 805.8 (>> 9, the 3-sigma threshold)

verdict: Conditional on the fixed-z_T=5 M1 NoLambda distance relation and the Chandrasekhar luminosity prescription, Pantheon+ constrains the SN Ia progenitor tracking fraction. Full tracking (eps = 1.0) incurs Delta chi2 = 805.8 after re-optimizing the nonnegative line-of-sight shear and magnitude intercept; the interpolated upper bound is eps < 0.150 at Delta chi2 = 9. No BBH population evolution, host-to-source transfer, or GW selection function is fitted, so this is not a model-independent bound on standard-siren source masses.
